title: ValueBench: Towards Comprehensively Evaluating Value Orientations and Understanding of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using rephrased items from cultural psychometric inventories, such as Hofstede's Value Survey Module (VSM13) and Social Axioms, to measure dimensions like individualism, power distance, masculinity, and uncertainty avoidance.

Applying rephrased questions from moral psychometric tests, such as the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) inventories, to assess the models' orientations toward care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and purity.

Transforming first-person statements from established personality tests (e.g., HEXACO, Big Five, NEO-PI-R) into advice-seeking questions to measure psychological dimensions like extraversion, agreeableness, neuroticism, and empathy.
Using general value inventories, such as the Study of Values (SOV), to measure the models' intrinsic orientations toward political and economic value dimensions.
Utilizing inventories like the Study of Values (SOV) and Social Axioms (SA) to evaluate the models' orientations regarding religious values, beliefs, and religiosity.
